create_trajectory_frame_from_atoms: create a TrajectoryFrame from an ASE Atoms object with step number and optional time
convert_trajectory_frame_to_dict: convert a TrajectoryFrame to a dictionary for Parquet serialization with all available fields
write_trajectory_to_parquet: write MD trajectory frames to a parquet file using ParquetTrajectoryWriter with buffered writes
append_frame_to_parquet_writer: append a TrajectoryFrame to a ParquetTrajectoryWriter buffer that auto flushes at interval
use_parquet_writer_context_manager: use ParquetTrajectoryWriter as a context manager to write trajectory data and auto close on exit
